newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds close up, new issue raises NLG 3.6 bn.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds close up, new issue raises NLG 3.6 bn.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Dutch bonds end up, although slightly off early highs, with most attention on the new 10 year benchmark. Traders mostly buy the Feb 2007 tap in the first hour as the price rises from 100.65 to 101.00. In total 3.6 billion guilders raised.
Sales resume at 0800 GMT on Tuesday. Public holiday in U.S.
* Jan 2006 +0.12 to 103.02/10, bid yield 5.56 pct vs 5.58 pct.
* Spread of Jan '06s under Jan '07 bunds widens to -20 basis
